brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.desc: +2 STR; fists hit for 1d8. Solves problems with fists.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.desc: +1 STR, +1 DEX, +1 INT, +2 to hit, +1 AC. Knows the odds and uses them.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.desc: +2 INT, +4 max HP; potions heal 30% more. Turns rubbish into medicine.

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.desc: +2 CHA, +1 AC. Your companion fights like it means it.

hype_man.name: Hype Man
hype_man.desc: +2 CHA, +1 AC, +6 max HP. Works the crowd while working the room.

demolitionist.name: Demolitionist
demolitionist.desc: +2 DEX; bombs do 50% more damage. Loud.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.desc: +2 CHA, +1 AC. Knows a guy who knows a guy.

duellist.name: Duellist
duellist.desc: +2 DEX, +1 to hit. Insists on the proper forms.
